# Kition kit rules (read first)

<!-- kition-quality:begin (generated by kition-sdk tools/sync-quality.mjs; edit the template there) -->
## Quality rules (read first)

- Tests are the spec. Read `docs/quality.md` and the feature catalogue (`features.yaml`)
  before changing behaviour. When code and a case disagree, the case wins unless a maintainer
  approves changing the case.
- Before you finish any task, run `cargo xtask ci`. If it fails, the task is not done. Claude Code
  runs it for you through the Stop hook; agents without hooks (Codex) run it by hand and
  report the real exit code.
- Never edit expected results to make a test pass: files under `cases/**/expected/`, paths
  listed under `protected` in `features.yaml`, and the `expected`, `tolerance`, `reference`,
  `input` and `steps` of an existing `case.yaml`. If you believe an expected result is wrong,
  stop and explain why in the task's findings; only a maintainer approves expected-result changes.
- Never weaken a test to make it pass: no deleted or loosened assertions, no added
  `#[ignore]`, `.skip`, `.only` or `.todo`, no raised tolerances. kition-sdk's
  `tools/check-expected.mjs` lists every such change for the maintainers.
- Every bug fix starts with a failing case under `cases/regressions/issue-<n>/`, then the fix.
- Every new feature adds an entry to `features.yaml` and at least one gate case.
- Put the task id and the case ids in the commit message.
- Stage only your own files: `git add` them by name; never `git commit -a` or `git add -A`.
  Other sessions may have uncommitted work in the same checkout.
- Work on `kition-slide` only in its main checkout; never change, build, or commit in its worktrees (`kition-slide-wt/*`, `kition-*-wt`, `kition-naming-work`).
- Never start `cargo xtask eval` (the real-model `layer: eval` cases): only a maintainer starts it (F-QA-16). Write eval cases and check them with `--dry-run`, which calls no model.
- No compatibility layers: no aliases, old names, old file suffixes, migrations, or readers for
  old formats. Delete a replaced path in the same change.
<!-- kition-quality:end -->

This repository is Kition's `kit.scene` kit: a 3D scene editor (modeling, materials, lights,
cameras, renders) whose engine is Kition's own, in Rust.

- Read Kition's `docs/kits.md` and this repository's `docs/design.md` before kit work. The
  Kit Harness Protocol (KHP) and the kit platform contracts live in kition-sdk and khp;
  change them there, never here.
- **Clean room.** The feature set and defaults are checked against Blender as a reference
  application (its user manual, its behaviour, and its output files), the way other kits check
  against Office or Photoshop. Blender's source code is GPL: never read, copy, port, or translate
  it into this repository, and never add a dependency on it. `tools/blender-reference/` only runs
  the Blender application to record facts (counts, sizes, defaults, renders).
- **Z up, metres, degrees.** The scene is Z-up and right-handed; commands and `inspect()` give
  rotations in degrees (XYZ Euler); the model stores radians. glTF's Y-up is converted at the
  file boundary only (`crates/formats/exchange`).
- **The viewport is the document.** The document's width and height are the editor's viewport
  size (`view.resize`); `render` draws the viewport in software, the same picture the agent's
  screenshot gets. View, shading, and selection are session state saved with the file
  (`editor` in `scene.json`); they never make the document dirty.
- **One command, one undo step.** Every scene change is a command that runs on the document and
  becomes one undo step; a failing command changes nothing. Drags in the viewport tools are one
  step each.
- `bindings/wasm` must keep passing `kition_kit::testing::check_contract`, and `kit.json` must
  pass kition-sdk's `tools/check-manifest.mjs` (`cargo xtask manifest`).
- The editor (`web/`) draws on `@kition/kit-editor` with the host's theme tokens; files go only
  through the host. Never run the engine on the page's thread.
- Code, comments, docs, tests, fixtures, and commit messages are English. No host paths, user
  names, or secrets in tracked files.
- No CI workflows in this repository besides the Package workflow (`.github/workflows/package.yml`),
  which Kition's reusable workflow runs to publish the kit's package.

## Never crash

- No panics in non-test code: no `unwrap()`, `expect()`, `panic!`, `unreachable!`, `todo!`,
  `unimplemented!`, no slice indexing (`get()` instead); no `unsafe`. The workspace lints deny
  them; tests may use them (`.clippy.toml`).
- Errors are `Result`s with typed reasons (`invalid-params`, `not-found`, `not-allowed`, ...).
  Input-derived numbers are hostile: finite checks, checked arithmetic, size caps.
- Every crash fix lands with a regression test.

## Working here

- `cargo xtask ci` before every commit. Parallel agents: separate `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` per agent.
